en.headline: Police arrest woman over debt restructuring scam involving HK$4.9 million
en.dek: A 45-year-old woman was charged with conspiracy to defraud after allegedly posing as bank staff and an accountant to collect cash from six victims in shared offices.
body: Police have arrested a 45-year-old woman on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud in a series of debt restructuring scams that involved a total of HK$4.9 million, officers said.

According to police, the arrested woman is linked to six cases. Victims reported receiving calls from people claiming to be bank staff who offered debt restructuring services. The victims were then instructed to meet someone claiming to be an accountant's office staff in shared offices in Mong Kok and Cheung Sha Wan, where they handed over cash.

Police said about HK$1 million in cash was recovered from the arrested woman. The woman was charged with one count of conspiracy to defraud and appeared in West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday morning. Investigations continue.
Officers used closed-circuit television footage under the 'Sharp Eyes' programme to identify the suspect, who was arrested in the Sham Shui Po area.

zh.headline: 警方破債務重組騙案拘45歲女子涉款490萬元
zh.dek: 45歲女子被控串謀詐騙，涉嫌冒充銀行職員及會計師，在共享辦公室向六名受害人收取現金。
body: 警方拕捕一名45歲女子，涉嫌在多宗債務重組騙案中串謀詐騙，涉款共490萬元。
警方表示，被捕女子與六宗案件有關。受害人報稱接獲自稱銀行職員的來電，對方聲稱可提供債務重組服務。受害人其後按指示前往旺角及長沙灣的共享辦公室，與自稱會計師樓職員的人會面並交出現金。
警方在被捕人身上起回約100萬元現金。該名女子被控一項串謀詐騙罪，周四早上在西九龍裁判法院提堂。調查仍在進行。
警方透過「銳眼計劃」的閉路電視片段鎖定疑犯身份，並在深水埗區將她拕捕。
